subtitle: Inside the model, then outside behavior, then the eval harness. Finish able to inspect how a model computes and to judge what it produces with evidence.

tracks.foundation: Inside the model: maths, activations and how data moves through the network. Side paths cover trees, rewards and GANs.
tracks.llm-systems: Outside the model: prompts, generation behavior, retrieval and scoring answers with evidence.
tracks.systems-production: Further out: the eval harness, automation and shipping with measurable quality.
